SRC-012:R001.text: All existing foundational functionality is preserved.

SRC-012:R002.text: Canonical SAIPEN documentation and public claims are checked against verifiable source snapshots.

SRC-012:R003.text: Meaningful upstream changes produce precise deterministic impact reports.

SRC-012:R004.text: Content blocks and page sections can be added, edited, reordered and removed through a documented low-friction workflow.

SRC-012:R005.text: Stable IDs and source locks protect against accidental global invalidation.

SRC-012:R006.text: Segmented documentation translations remain independently versioned and stale-aware.

SRC-012:R007.text: EN/ET/RU pilot translation work is genuinely completed as far as the available review and font requirements allow; unresolved approvals are truthfully reported.

SRC-012:R008.text: The system can represent 33 or more language configurations without language-specific application branches.

SRC-012:R009.text: The 10-locale scale fixture, 33-locale expansion plan and script/font readiness are tested and measured rather than merely described.
